name: 34997 · Stuart, FL
findings: ZIP 34997 (Stuart) has 134 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34997 (Stuart) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 34997 (Stuart) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.5 times the typical level).
